system.description:
The target takes [SR] stacks of [Pursuit: 7]. These [Pursuit] stacks may be divided amongst characters within range as you please.

(Fate 1): Add +1 to the number of [Pursuit] stacks. 
(Fate 2): Add +2 to the number of [Pursuit] stacks. 
(CR11): The [Pursuit] rating increases to 15. 
(CR21): The [Pursuit] rating increases to 24.

A special skill that destroys the enemy's defense by throwing one strategy after another according to the tactical standard. Attacks aimed at a disturbed posture inflict deep damage on the enemy.
